zh.title: CoolFly Aircraft稱Dream ST電動飛行器已準備交付
zh.summary: CoolFly Aircraft稱單人座Dream ST電動垂直起降機已準備交付。
body: CoolFly Aircraft表示，其Dream ST個人電動垂直起降（eVTOL）飛行器已準備交付。該機採單人開放式座艙設計，瞄準超輕型航空器市場。
Dream ST曾在法國進行載人飛行。該公司表示，該機也於10月在馬爾地夫完成一次載人跨島飛行。
CoolFly Aircraft提供的性能資料指出，Dream ST最大酬載為95公斤；搭載70公斤飛行員時，飛行時間為16分鐘。

en.title: CoolFly Aircraft Says Dream ST Electric Aircraft Is Ready for Delivery
en.summary: CoolFly Aircraft says its single-seat Dream ST electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft is ready for delivery.
body: CoolFly Aircraft says its seated Dream ST personal electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft is ready for delivery. The single-seat model has an open cockpit and is aimed at the ultralight aircraft market.
Dream ST has made crewed flights in France. The company also said the aircraft completed a crewed island-to-island flight in the Maldives in October.
CoolFly puts Dream ST’s maximum payload at 95 kilograms. Its stated flight time is 16 minutes with a pilot weighing 70 kilograms.

zh.title: 印度航空檢討成本 研議與印度快運航空加強合作
zh.summary: 印度航空面臨全年虧損逾2,200億盧比的壓力，董事會已研究多項降低成本的方案。
body: 中央社引述印度媒體報導，截至2026年3月底的財政年度，印度航空虧損逾2,200億印度盧比。董事會已研究降低成本的方案，包括與旗下低成本業者印度快運航空加強合作。
印度新聞信託社指出，燃油價格上漲推高營運成本，巴基斯坦空域限制影響國際航班，供應鏈問題也拖慢機隊擴張和更新。這些壓力出現在印度航空試圖改善服務及強化航網之際。
據中央社報導，公司另組成跨部門團隊研議節省成本。加強兩家航空公司合作仍屬評估中的方案，報導未指出已決定合併或調整航線。

en.title: Air India reviews costs and considers closer cooperation with Air India Express
en.summary: The carrier is weighing cost reductions after its fiscal 2026 loss exceeded 220 billion rupees.
body: Air India is reviewing ways to cut costs after losses exceeded 220 billion rupees in the financial year ended March 2026, Taiwan’s Central News Agency reported, citing Indian media. Its board has considered closer cooperation with low-cost subsidiary Air India Express.

The Press Trust of India attributed the pressure to rising fuel costs, Pakistani airspace restrictions affecting international operations and supply constraints that slowed fleet expansion and renewal.

Central News Agency reported that the company also put together a cross-functional team to identify savings. Closer cooperation remains under consideration, with no merger decision or route changes reported.

zh.title: Embraer 與 Envoy Air 延長 E-Jet 客機重度維修協議
zh.summary: Embraer 將在美國兩處設施繼續為 Envoy Air 提供補充重度維修，並增加專屬維修產能。
body: Embraer 與美國區域航空公司 Envoy Air 宣佈延長 E-Jet 重度維修合約。補充維修作業將繼續由喬治亞州梅肯與德州沃斯堡的設施承接，擴大後的協議將增加專門提供給 Envoy 的維修產能。
Envoy 是美國航空集團全資子公司。Embraer 表示，Envoy 目前營運189架 E-Jet，並持續接收新機，機隊規模承諾至少達214架。
Embraer 同時在沃斯堡的佩羅菲爾德聯盟機場投資約7,000萬美元興建新維修設施，預計2027年啟用。原廠估計，該設施完工後，可使其在美國的 E-Jet 維修服務產能增加逾五成。

en.title: Embraer and Envoy Air extend heavy maintenance agreement for E-Jet aircraft
en.summary: Embraer will continue supplemental heavy maintenance at two US sites and allocate more capacity to Envoy.
body: Embraer and Envoy Air have extended their US heavy maintenance agreement for E-Jets. Supplemental work will continue in Macon, Georgia, and Fort Worth, Texas, with the expanded deal giving Envoy more dedicated maintenance capacity.
Envoy, an American Airlines Group subsidiary, operates 189 E-Jets and continues taking deliveries toward a minimum fleet commitment of 214 aircraft, according to Embraer.

Separately, Embraer is investing about $70 million in a commercial maintenance facility at Perot Field Alliance Airport (AIA) in Fort Worth. It expects the facility to open in 2027 and expand its US E-Jet service capacity by more than half.
